M-TEST.NAME: Trusted command execution
M-TEST.purpose: Execute project-declared verification commands safely: canonical command source, trust record, argv-only execution, quote-aware splitting (ADR-1, ADR-4).

fn-parseTestFiles.PURPOSE: Structural <test-files> entries from a verification file.

fn-parseCheckCommand.PURPOSE: First declared check command with a config fallback.

fn-inspectCheckCommand.PURPOSE: Flags shell-style commands that need explicit opt-in.

fn-planModuleTest.PURPOSE: Pure plan: files, command, argv, source and validation errors.

fn-executeModulePlan.PURPOSE: Authorize then spawn one plan; never throws for findings.

fn-runModuleTests.PURPOSE: Plan plus execute convenience used by verify and tests.

fn-computeTrustHashes.PURPOSE: sha256 of docs/modules, docs/verification and the config.

fn-checkTrust.PURPOSE: Hash comparison with actionable stale/missing details.

contract.purpose: Execute project-declared verification commands safely: canonical command source, trust record, argv-only execution, quote-aware splitting (ADR-1, ADR-4).

param.name: moduleId
param.description: Module id to plan tests for.

param.name: plan
param.description: Spanwable command with source and validation state.

error.description: No valid trust record and no opt-in (exit 2).
Test-file entry escapes the project or starts with -.

notes.note-1: No shell interpolation: argv-only spawnSync with shell false.
notes.note-2: Trust is content-based: editing docs/modules, docs/verification or the config invalidates the record.
notes.note-3: Command source precedence is documentation: verification file (canonical), module file (deprecated), config testRunner.
